facts: The Claimant was employed by the Respondent from 1 September 2017 and, from January 2020, worked as a Band 8c Consultant Clinical Psychologist. Patient X was both a service user and an employee of the Respondent. The Claimant began treating Patient X in June 2021, and in March 2022 they began exchanging romantic messages while treatment continued. Patient X was discharged from the Claimant's care on 21 April 2022, and their relationship continued afterwards. In September 2023 Patient X raised concerns about the relationship, after which the Respondent began safeguarding, regulatory and disciplinary steps. The Claimant was redeployed to non-patient-facing duties, allegations were put to her in October 2023, and a disciplinary investigation and hearing followed. The Claimant resigned on 10 April 2024 after the disciplinary hearing.
